packet: FA2-T8 product 3.2: Diagnose answers are fixed sample text, not model output

answer.likelyCause: The Service web selects app=web, but the Pods of Deployment web carry app=web-v2.
answer.explanation: No Pod matches the selector, so the Service has no endpoints. Another possibility is that the Deployment was renamed on purpose and the Service was not updated.
answer.fix:
kubectl -n shop get pods -l app=web --show-labels
kubectl -n shop edit service web   # set spec.selector.app to web-v2
